sanskrit_verse:
ते पृष्टास् तु यथा ब्रूयुः सीमासन्धिषु लक्षणम् ।
तत् तथा स्थापयेत् राजा धर्मेण ग्रामयोः द्वयोः ॥
transliteration: te pṛṣṭās tu yathā brūyuḥ sīmāsandhiṣu lakṣaṇam | tat tathā sthāpayet rājā dharmeṇa grāmayor dvayoḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When questioned, those who speak truthfully regarding boundary markers shall be established accordingly by the king through Dharma, for the integrity of both villages.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in truthful witness-bearing at contested boundaries
Causation arises from alignment with perceptible boundary signs
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by direct knowledge and presence
Restoration logic prioritizes territorial harmony over adversarial claims
Consciousness alignment ensures unbiased testimony in spatial disputes
executable_legal_axioms: IF a boundary dispute exists BETWEEN two settlements THEN a witness who speaks according to visible boundary markers SHALL BE recognized as authoritative
IF a ruler receives conflicting testimonies REGARDING a shared border THEN the testimony aligned with observable boundary signs SHALL GUIDE resolution
WHEN a claimant demonstrates factual awareness of physical demarcations THEN their standing in the matter SHALL BE elevated automatically
ALL boundary decisions MUST prioritize mutual recognition between communities OVER punitive assignment of fault
supreme_court_application: At the highest judicial level, this axiom mandates that Supreme Courts validate boundary resolutions based on empirical indicators and truthful testimony rather than abstract legal contention. The court's role becomes one of alignment with natural jurisdictional markers, ensuring that verdicts restore communal balance without assigning punitive liability.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality is fulfilled when testimony aligns with visible boundary evidence. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential clarification of spatial integrity. Proportional responsibility lies not in blame but in accurate representation of land markers. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that justice is served through harmonious re-establishment of shared space.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Re-inscribe lost or disputed boundary markers using verified witness accounts
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Encourage joint village council participation in reaffirming borders
Capacity Restoration: Provide tools and records for ongoing maintenance of boundary clarity
Integrity Reintegration: Conduct ceremonial affirmation of mutual respect across village limits
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma is executed through rightful testimony and spatial integrity. Justice flows from consciousness-aligned discernment, not punitive judgment. The boundary stands firm in truth; the villages dwell in harmony. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
